tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Palette. Do not use directly in components; use bg, raised, on-band.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Palette (intentional addition, not in the mockup). Behind line-strong: 3.6:1 on white, 3.4:1 on gray-50.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Palette. SAVIS navy: behind ink and surface-inverse.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Palette. SAVIS blue: behind brand, focus, info.

tokens.name: blue-800
tokens.usage: Palette. Hero/band gradient start; text of the white button on band.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Palette (intentional addition). Behind success: 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Palette (intentional addition). Behind error: 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and header background. Text, ink and muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alternating sections, search field, even table rows. Text and muted read on it.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, tables, inputs. Always paired with a line border.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Table headers, active filter chip, dark caption fallback. on-band text reads on it (15.9:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings (Sora) and emphasised text on bg, surface, raised (14.8:1+).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on bg, surface, raised (14.3:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, card descriptions, captions, input labels' hints on bg, surface, raised (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative borders and dividers of cards, sections, tables. Not for form controls (1.2:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, selects, search field, filter chips (3.4:1+ on bg and surface).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links on hover, eyebrows, pillar numbers, 'go' links. Brand text on bg/surface/raised is 5.4:1+.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline on light grounds (5.4:1+). On band, hero and footer use on-band.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Decorative accent only (2.3:1 on white): illustration strokes, never text or focus on light grounds.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Stat top rule, eyebrow rule and glows on band/hero only.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Flat band fill: pillar lead card, mega-menu feature, stat strip. on-band reads on it (7.3:1).

tokens.name: band-light
tokens.usage: Hero/band gradient end. on-band-muted reads on it (4.9:1).

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on band, hero, footer, surface-inverse.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Lead, descriptions, breadcrumbs on band and hero (4.8:1+ across the gradient).

tokens.name: band-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, lead pillar number and 'more' links on band (6.1:1).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Tag/chip fill. chip-ink reads on it.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info alert icon and title on info-bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success alert icon/title on success-bg; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text on warn-bg (5.4:1); always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Field error text, error alert icon/title on error-bg and bg; always with a word or icon.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Hero H1. In code use fs-display-1.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. In code use fs-h2.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers on band (tabular-nums). In code use fs-stat.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Hero lead. In code use fs-lead.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards; between small buttons.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Button side padding; tile and CTA padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Hero column gap; footer column gap.

tokens.name: radius-feature
tokens.usage: Mega-menu feature, CTA banner, news cards.

fluid.note: Responsive font sizes used in code; the Typography view shows each at its maximum.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any control (filter chips, icon buttons).
